description.name: Entry
description.text:
Grants [Quick ATB 1] to Machinists, grants Master Mode, [Instant ATB 1] & Starry Old Guy's Lead to user
Master Mode: Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Starry Old Guy's Lead: [Machinist Damage +25%] or [Damage +5% & 50 SB Charge] to party if user has/does not have Job Synergy
Interval Chase: [Single-target minor DeProtect for 5 seconds & Machinist Damage +30/35/40/45/50% to party] or [10 single-target Prismatic/NE ranged physical attacks, 10% Stoneskin & Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party] after 1/2/3/4/5 chases if user has/does not have Job Synergy (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Prismatic/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Weakness Damage +30% for 1 turn to party, removes Master Mode

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999
